modalLead: This release is about a faster, more private, more consistent dashboard: the browser theme colour now matches whatever theme you pick, the default font is self-hosted (no third-party requests), non-essential scripts load out of the way of first paint, and the What's new history now shows the 25 most recent releases.

items.text: Self-hosted font — the default Source Code Pro font is now bundled with nextDash instead of loaded from Google Fonts. That removes a third-party request on every page, keeps the app fully working offline, and stops any font-related call leaving your machine.

Faster first paint — the discovery/tour promo scripts no longer block the dashboard from rendering; they load after the page is interactive, so bookmarks appear sooner (about 106 KB moved off the critical path).

Correct browser theme colour — the mobile browser bar and installed-app (PWA) chrome now match the background of whatever theme you're using, including every built-in and custom theme. Previously only light and dark showed the right colour and everything else fell back to blue.

More history — this modal now shows the 25 most recent releases instead of 7. The newest loads first and the rest still load on demand as you scroll, each with its own loading skeleton, so opening the modal stays fast.

Consistent cache-busting — every dashboard, config, and health stylesheet is now versioned from one place, so a release reliably refreshes styles in your browser instead of occasionally serving a stale file.
